card.name: Passing on teachings in religious history
card.fires_on: Small words like 'the' or 'of' right after verbs of handing down or giving a religious teaching or law, such as transmitted, discovered, proclaimed or gave him. Seen in passages on Bön, Buddhism and Moses at Sinai.

modes.label: Article after transmit/give verb
modes.description: 'the' follows a verb of transmitting, discovering or proclaiming a faith, law or instructions.

modes.label: Link words in transmission phrases
modes.description: 'of' or 'a' in phrases about the origin or handing down of a tradition.
modes.example: the arrival of Padmasambhava represents the First Transmission<< of>> the faith.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words about giving or receiving, such as received, delivered and granted.
card.plain: It fires on little words just before the thing that was handed down or received, such as a faith, a law or instructions.
